title: JOLTS Job Openings (Oct 2026)
source: EST: bls.gov/schedule/news_release/jolts.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-05, reads verbatim 'October 2026 | Dec. 01, 2026 | 10:00 AM'; corroborated negatively by bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched_list.htm (same fetch), which lists nothing at all on 2026-11-30 and puts the September-data JOLTS on 11-03. Filed estimate rather than confirmed/BLS: DESPITE the primary, because a third bls.gov view contradicts it — the November month grid (bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched.htm, same fetch) returned 'Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (October 2026) at 10:00 AM' on November 30. Two of three primaries say 12-01 and the grid view is the form a summarizing fetcher most easily mis-reads (a 12-01 cell adjacent to the trailing November row), but a wrong date silently corrupts every window keyed to it, so the contradiction widens caution instead of being resolved away. Re-read the December schedule before promoting
notes: Labor-demand read landing the same 10:00 ET slot as ISM Manufacturing (ism-manufacturing-2026-12-01), three days before jobs-2026-12-04 and eight before the fomc-2026-12-09 SEP/dot-plot meeting, with the committee already in blackout (fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28, through 12-10). Either resolution of the date conflict above leaves the finding it came out of intact: the chicago-pmi-2026-11-30 research needed to establish what releases on 2026-11-30 and found the 08:30 slot empty across BEA, Census and BLS — JOLTS is a 10:00 release on both candidate dates, so it lands after that ledger's 09:45-09:50 measurement window closes either way. It changes the 11-30 SESSION read materially and the WINDOW read not at all. Discovered during the chicago-pmi-2026-11-30 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05).
